preferred_referent: 📍 Online School — Education Kernel Embryo / Operating Company
goal: Develop Online School as an operating company around the shared education kernel: repeatedly reground on the person actually evidenced now, preserve prior learner relations as natural provenance, and construct person-specific paths to knowledge without allowing identity, grade, schedule, or prior models to define the learner.
next_movement: Run the learner-first workspace as the current school entrance. Let real observations establish and change current learner relations, then use those relations to choose among educational actuators rather than defaulting to schedule order or worksheets. Next, connect returned artifact/handoff evidence back into observations so learner regrounding can occur from actual school movement without manual re-entry.
walls: Do not publish minor learner identities or individualized private records in the public company layer.
Do not treat the existing homeschool schedule as proof of accreditation, licensure, incorporation, or external customer outcomes.
Do not collapse the company into a single product; products/services are outputs of the company.
Do not overwrite the private household schedule when generalizing the reusable company operation.
